lines.gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: thaakur ke sevak har ra(n)g maanahi ||
lines.translation: The servant of the Lord and Master enjoys the Love and Affection of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਾ ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਾਹਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jo kichh thaakur kaa so sevak kaa sevak thaakur hee sa(n)g jaahar jeeu ||3||
lines.translation: That which belongs to the Lord and Master, belongs to His servant. The servant becomes distinguished in association with his Lord and Master. ||3||
He, whom the Lord and Master dresses in the robes of honor,
Is not called to answer for his account any longer.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਸੋ ਗਹਿਰ ਗਭੀਰਾ ਗਉਹਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੮॥੨੫॥
lines.transliteration: tis sevak kai naanak kurabaanee so gahir gabheeraa gauhar jeeu ||4||18||25||
lines.translation: Nanak is a sacrifice to that servant. He is the pearl of the deep and unfathomable Ocean of God. ||4||18||25||
Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh ghar mahi baahar naahee ||
lines.translation: Everything is within the home of the self; there is nothing beyond.
One who searches outside is deluded by doubt.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜਿਨੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੋ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee jinee a(n)tar paaiaa so a(n)tar baahar suhelaa jeeu ||1||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, one who has found the Lord within is happy, inwardly and outwardly. ||1||
Slowly, gently, drop by drop, the stream of nectar trickles down within.
The mind drinks it in, hearing and reflecting on the Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: anad binod kare din raatee sadaa sadaa har kelaa jeeu ||2||
lines.translation: It enjoys bliss and ecstasy day and night, and plays with the Lord forever and ever. ||2||
I have now been united with the Lord after having been separated and cut off from Him for so many lifetimes;
by the Grace of the Holy Saint, the dried-up branches have blossomed forth again in their greenery.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਮਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਏ ਮੇਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sumat paae naam dhiaae guramukh hoe melaa jeeu ||3||
lines.translation: I have obtained this sublime understanding, and I meditate on the Naam; as Gurmukh, I have met the Lord. ||3||
As the waves of water merge again with the water,
so does my light merge again into the Light.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕਟੇ ਕਿਵਾੜਾ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਹੋਈਐ ਜਉਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੯॥੨੬॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak bhram kate kivaaRaa bahuR na hoeeai jaulaa jeeu ||4||19||26||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, the veil of illusion has been cut away, and I shall not go out wandering any more. ||4||19||26||
Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
I am a sacrifice to those who have heard of You.
I am a sacrifice to those whose tongues speak of You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਰਿ ਵਾਰਿ ਜਾਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਜੋ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: vaar vaar jaaee tis vitahu jo man tan tudh aaraadhe jeeu ||1||
lines.translation: Again and again, I am a sacrifice to those who meditate on You with mind and body. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਚਰਣ ਪਖਾਲੀ ਜੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਾਲੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis charan pakhaalee jo terai maarag chaalai ||
lines.translation: I wash the feet of those who walk upon Your Path.
With my eyes, I long to behold those kind people.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਦੇਵਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਾਜਨ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਾਧੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: man devaa tis apune saajan jin gur mil so prabh laadhe jeeu ||2||
lines.translation: I offer my mind to those friends, who have met the Guru and found God. ||2||
Very fortunate are those who know You.
In the midst of all, they remain detached and balanced in Nirvaanaa.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਨਿ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਰਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਦੂਤ ਉਨਿ ਸਾਧੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: saadh kai sa(n)g un bhaujal tariaa sagal doot un saadhe jeeu ||3||
lines.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, they cross over the terrifying world-ocean, and conquer all their evil passions. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tin kee saran pariaa man meraa ||
lines.translation: My mind has entered their Sanctuary.
I have renounced my pride in my own strength, and the darkness of emotional attachment.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੦॥੨੭॥
lines.transliteration: naam daan deejai naanak kau tis prabh agam agaadhe jeeu ||4||20||27||
lines.translation: Please bless Nanak with the Gift of the Naam, the Name of the Inaccessible and Unfathomable God. ||4||20||27||
Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
You are the tree; Your branches have blossomed forth.
From the very small and subtle, You have become huge and manifest.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਜਲਨਿਧਿ ਤੂੰ ਫੇਨੁ ਬੁਦਬੁਦਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਲੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) jalanidh too(n) phen budabudaa tudh bin avar na bhaaleeai jeeu ||1||
lines.translation: You are the Ocean of Water, and You are the foam and the bubbles on its surface. I cannot see any other except You, Lord. ||1||
You are the thread, and You are also the beads.
You are the knot, and You are the primary bead of the maalaa.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਮਧਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਦਿਖਾਲੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: aad madh a(n)t prabh soee avar na koi dikhaaleeai jeeu ||2||
lines.translation: In the beginning, in the middle and in the end, there is God. I cannot see any other except You, Lord. ||2||
You transcend all qualities, and You possess the supreme qualities. You are the Giver of peace.
You are detached in Nirvaanaa, and You are the Enjoyer, imbued with love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਪਣੇ ਕਰਤਬ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਆਪੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: apane karatab aape jaanahi aape tudh samaaleeai jeeu ||3||
lines.translation: You Yourself know Your Own Ways; You dwell upon Yourself. ||3||
You are the Master, and then again, You are the servant.
O God, You Yourself are the Manifest and the Unmanifest.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਇਕ ਭੋਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੧॥੨੮॥
lines.transliteration: naanak daas sadaa gun gaavai ik bhoree nadar nihaaleeai jeeu ||4||21||28||
lines.translation: Slave Nanak sings Your Glorious Praises forever. Please, just for a moment, bless him with Your Glance of Grace. ||4||21||28||
